content: The American Diabetes Association (ADA) actively supports the development and implementation of policies and payment models designed to address social and economic obstacles that hinder access to healthcare. These payment models should be structured to facilitate comprehensive, system-wide strategies aimed at ensuring equitable diabetes care. This includes aligning healthcare costs with the financial capabilities of patients, thereby reducing the financial strain on individuals. Additionally, these models should aim to minimize administrative complexities that patients often face when trying to obtain essential diabetes medications and devices.
